creative_direction.name: Ultramarine Courtyard Sundial
creative_direction.brief: A photographic courtyard moment: a deep ultramarine lime-washed wall meets a continuous pale limestone ground at a low horizon, one hard diagonal shadow edge raking the wall from upper left like late sun across a patio. The flacon stands flush on that ground at its true base line, its own measured contact shadow anchoring it, while the right half of the wall stays calm for a wrapped narrow-sans column: brand at column head, the name set large across two wrapped lines, eau de parfum line and a short rule closing the column. Vertical overlap with the shoulder but wide horizontal clearance keeps the two-column editorial grid honest; mineral matte against lacquer gloss tells the whole story.
creative_direction.material: lime-washed plaster wall with honed limestone ground
creative_direction.lighting: hard direct sunlight casting one crisp diagonal shadow edge on the wall, bright warm ambient on the ground
